sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Correct watch order, sticky nav bar, faster loading, redesigned widgets

- Watch order now comes from the curated Shikimori franchise (sorted by
  release date, no crossovers); main entries first, specials on demand;
  each row resolves its AnimeLib title lazily and is cached
- Title page shows a navigation bar background and title once the header
  is scrolled away (no more 'Назад' over content)
- GET responses cached in memory (5 min) and title data on disk: the title
  page paints instantly from the last visit, then refreshes
- Images are decoded straight to screen size via ImageIO (big backgrounds
  no longer stall scrolling)
- Widgets redesigned: poster-based Continue (small/medium with recent list),
  Upcoming with covers of your titles and time chips, plus lock screen
  widgets (rectangular / circular); refresh right after the next episode
